The main theme of this session is §1-§3 of Thurson's minimal stretch.Definition For hyperbolic structures on the surface , . and . Trivial facts: ; satisfies the triangle inequality. is not symmetric in general. Consider the genus 2 surfaces with very long 'neck', the ratio of length of neck is while the ratio of perimeter of the 'neck' is , so the Lipschitz constants are different. and iff . The proof is by area argument. Is it true for coned case? Any possible restriction? Why? Theorem 3.1 ( positive) For , .
Try to understand the proof of Theorem 3.1.The next topic is to show is attained by simple closed curves. The case of a pair of pants is typical, and implies the general case.Lemma 3.4 (shrinking at the waist) Let be hyperbolic structures on a pair of pants. If for which is not homotopic to the boundary, then .
Assuming Lemma 3.4. If is not simple, with some self-intersection at , then there is some immersed figure-8, say . The covering space of corresponding to the group is a pair of pants. The lift of in is not homotopic to the boundary (the 2 generators both appear), thus the sup is not attained. Go back to , the quotient of the boundary element gives a larger value of .This gives the Proposition 3.5 (supremum simple).
Try to understand the proof of Lemma 3.4.Remark The rough idea of the proof is to find some element of maximal stretch, where the Lipschitz number can be attained. This coincides with the latter proof of in the case of maximal stretch lamination Consider 4-coned sphere with angles , Gauss-Bonnet gives , so a natural restriction is . To use the area argument for , the area is important.Example Map an ideal triangle to a non-ideal triangle.
For example, we can extend the sides of the non-ideal triangle to the boundary, and connect the boundary point, to get an ideal triangle. Up to a Möbius transform, the problem is to 'shrink' an ideal triangle to a smaller triangle.In the upper half plane model, one example is and One possible way is nearest point projection, FACT: in a CAT(0) space, the nearest point projection is 1-Lipschitz (consider a quadrilateral comparison, there are 2 obtuse angles!)We can actually calculate the expression of n.p.p. info_showOrphanNodes.description: 显示未连接到任何其他节点的节点。

info_showAttachments.description: 将附件（如图像和PDF）显示为图中的节点。

info_allowGlobalGraph.description: 允许用户查看所有节点的全局图。

info_allowExpand.description: 允许用户将图形视图弹出至全屏显示。

info_attractionForce.description: 链接节点之间的吸引力有多大？吸引力越大，图形将显得越集中。

info_linkLength.description: 节点之间的链接应有多长？链接越短，节点将聚集得更紧密。

info_repulsionForce.description: 节点之间的排斥力有多大？排斥力越大，分离的节点将分散得越远。

info_centralForce.description: 节点被吸引到中心的程度有多大？吸引力越大，图形看起来越密集和呈圆形。

info_edgePruning.description: 超过此阈值长度的边将不会显示，但仍然参与图形计算。这有助于大型复杂图形显得更加有序。悬停在节点上时，仍会显示这些链接。

info_minNodeRadius.description: 最小节点的大小是多少？节点越小，吸引其他节点的力量越小。

info_maxNodeRadius.description: 最大节点的大小是多少？节点大小取决于它们的链接数量。节点越大，吸引其他节点的力量越大。这有助于围绕最重要的节点形成良好的分组。

info_allowResizing.description: 是否允许用户调整侧边栏的大小

info_allowCollapsing.description: 是否允许用户折叠侧边栏
